role: Composite unit-step chirp implementation and full-FFT oracle.
logic: Lines 28–41 enforce unit multiplier, beta range, N=KM and K>=M. Compression forms d_r=sum_t S_rt x_rt; projected input is conjugate(S_rt)d_r, so P^2=MP and P/M is the orthogonal projector. Lines 124–154 use the parity-twisted gauge with monodromy -1, one K-point FFT, seed half the total gauged forcing, balanced exclusive prefix scan and permutation scatter. Both even and odd composite N are covered; prime-power factorization is not required.
cost: O(N+K log K) complex arithmetic and O(N) temporary storage for a row, including phase construction and padded reductions. The N-point FFT at lines 163–166 is explicitly a reference oracle. Rejection sampling has a finite call cap, not a certified bit cap.
guards: int64 phase products may overflow before reduction; float64 phase/complex128 FFT accuracy is not exact arithmetic. A wider dtype does not upgrade phases or the FFT, and pairwise_sum returns a Python complex. Conditional uniformity after accepted unit sampling is sound; aborts require a separate probability term.
evidence: The saved 1916 cycle and covariance artifacts and v13 direct comparisons remain accepted as finite numerical/history evidence. No broadening to exact DFT of arbitrary input, unlimited-size binary64, or zero-abort guarantees. No concrete stored-case failure identified.

Its FFT-call AST count is not whole-source correctness. Assertions rely on normal Python assertion settings.

If absent, exits successfully with no comparison. sys.path.append does not pin the imported prototype version or defeat earlier name shadowing. Local unit_step_core is the identified exact hash; historical prototype is unresolved from this script alone.

role: Small dense covariance-spectrum exploration.

evidence: composite_ratios.txt is accepted only as saved finite exploration. It does not certify all-N spectral upper bounds or exact rank from float thresholds.

role: Divisor-window composite plan, randomized rows and coordinate medians.

guards: The manually constructible dataclass is not a validation proof. Probability bounds require fixed input independent of random states, independent row draws and treatment of sampler aborts. Default fixed seed is not all-input random protection. Failure helper lacks general N/M/finite-number checks.

role: Exact fractional-offset-class lift over a prime-power sketch.

Each class modulates one padded input, applies one Q sketch under the same state, and retains only its frequency targets with sqrt(Q/N) scaling. Hence the advertised ideal O(hQ) omits literal sorting costs, even though an arithmetic-progression implementation can remove them.

role: Exact finite-field two-slope Gram and Fourier all-basis verifier.
logic: Finds/validates primitive roots at supplied primes, computes two-state Gram determinant and coefficients with exact modular inverse, checks projector idempotence and noncommutation, derives a direct-K-DFT/Green decoder, compares every projected input basis response and rejects dropping a slope. Driver uses four explicit compatible cases.
cost: Decoder uses K direct sums of K terms: O(K^2) modular exponentiation terms plus O(G) scan. Decoder-basis sweeps and all N^2 output entries cost much more than an executor; no FFT backend in the modular decoder. Local exponentiation/number-theory cost is not free at bit level.

role: Exact finite-field stationary full-rank chart verifier.
logic: Constructs distinct exponent nodes E(u), inverts Vandermonde W with pivoting, verifies W inverse and Toeplitz Gram, caches per-channel per-summary impulse responses only for verification, and compares all N^2 Fourier entries. Wrong-node mutation checks inverse coefficient differences.

Wrong mutation proves the inverse differs, rather than directly comparing its full transformed outputs; stronger independent audit later checks actual output mutations.

Energy subtraction clamped to zero can lose small residuals. One-root multiplication drift and int64 phase products apply. Helper constructed_union_signal lacks the full entry-point validation.

Fixed proper family only transforms its subspace exactly; worst-case relative error is one over arbitrary inputs. Bounded-q dense structured examples do not establish arbitrary-input exactness.

logic: Forms local V/Gamma, solves for projector diagonal, chooses the minimum-leverage coordinate in each block, and evaluates its Fourier projection. Since leverage sums to q, the impulse witness residual squared is at least 1-q/M. Driver checks four small two-slope families and trace defects.
cost: Per family O(K[Mq^2+q^3+q^2M]) dense Gram/solve work, plus full union evaluator. Leverage arrays and phase tensors use growing-q storage; not an independent linear-time generic procedure.
guards: No separate condition guard here before solve; supported example families and union evaluator provide checks. Floating leverage/trace tolerances are diagnostics. The theorem is for a fixed family, not input-adaptive state selection. Its sharpness over impulses must not be mistaken for minimax over all vectors.
evidence: LEVERAGE_RESULTS.json accepted as finite numerical witnesses. Exact broader proper-projector worst-case error one remains compatible. No invalidation of listed finite comparisons.

role: Dyadic one-root phase/gauge table and compact chirp decoder.
logic: Generates root table recursively from one primitive G-root, indexes local exponents, compresses blocks, performs one K FFT, uses half-total closure and balanced prefix scan. All caller-dependent arrays and shapes inspected. For even dyadic G/unit a the parity-free monodromy is -1.
cost: O(G+K log K) arithmetic per decode with O(G) table and buffers; root setup O(G) must be charged once when shared. Claim concerns algebraic roots/arithmetic, not exact binary root generation.
guards: Table creator requires dyadic G>=2; lower helpers only verify shape and inherited dimensions, not that table entries really are powers of the right primitive root. Intended callers supply correct table. Sequential multiplication causes O(Gu) drift; inverse root indexing and conjugation are only algebraically exact. int64 exponent overflow remains unguarded.
evidence: Source warning explicitly disclaims certified numeric implementation. Finite comparisons with np.exp and modular all-basis controls retained; no universal fixed-precision or exact integer-index certificate inferred.

role: Exact same-clock destination-collision enumeration.
logic: For a_i=1+iK, destinations at clock j number M/gcd(j,M). Dyadic valuation sum is (2M^2+1)/3; repeating K times yields K(2M^2+1)/3. Explicit sets and gcd-sum are compared across 15 driver cases.
cost: explicit_unique_pairs performs Theta(GM) integer residue visits and up to O(M) set memory per clock; analytic gcd sum O(G) gcd calls; closed formula O(1) big-integer operations. These are enumeration costs, not a fused transform implementation.
guards: predicted helper evaluates G%M before rejecting M=0 and does not require positive G. Driver uses valid positive dyadic parameters. exact helper relies on assumed dimensions. No saved-domain failure follows.
evidence: ORBIT_COLLISION_RESULTS.json agrees with the exact formula. The 2/3 limit shows only same-clock destination collisions save a constant fraction of visits; values need not agree and cross-clock algebraic reuse is outside scope. No universal complexity obstruction accepted.

role: Orthogonal beta-bank analysis, selection, energy identity and mixed-radix decoding.
logic: Setup validates dyadic factor dimensions/states or odd-only fallback. Masks normalize/deduplicate indices. Known-bank path applies P/M; analyzed path uses positive-sign local FFT_M summaries and exact energy ordering. Threshold/fixed-count selection is optimal among these bank-column subsets. Final Cooley–Tukey phase/odd FFT performed once. Independent projected-input helper and constructed signals also read.
cost: Known L banks: O(N+L[G+K log K]+N log(m+1)), memory O(N). Analysis adds O(N log M), selection sorting O(mM log(mM)); worst L=mM recovers FFT-scale or greater scanning. evaluate_mask proxy sets root setup to zero although fresh analyze_banks already constructed it, so fresh-input proxy needs +G. This changes constants, not asymptotic conclusion.
guards: Masks coerce int values; manually constructed BankAnalysis could bypass invariants. Exact epsilon=0 conservatively retains all banks. Float energy subtraction/clamping is explicitly diagnostic. In the odd-only case calls a full N FFT. Base phases via one-root tables share numerical limitations.
evidence: Saved experiments/PHASE14_SUMMARY distinguish exact-arithmetic identities from numerical outputs. Accept structured exactness and input-dependent energy identity, not zero numeric error or a guaranteed small bank count for every input. Dependency mixedradix exact identity pinned, not full dependency-closure coverage.

role: Top-level subprocess orchestrator for Phase14 and inherited tests.
logic: Nine commands use the current Python executable, fixed cwd and check=True: one unittest discovery invocation then finite fields, precision probe, new gates and experiments. Stops on subprocess failure; final all-passed/count string is hard-coded, not derived from unittest reports.
cost: Sum of every invoked workload, dominated by numerical/modular verifiers and inherited tests; no runtime theorem. Child stdout/stderr behavior is inherited. It executes code if launched, so it was only read here.
guards: Exact dependency module/script identities are mapped through the archive. Eight nonassigned dependency hashes were snapshotted hash-only and receive no full-read credit. Exit success does not independently prove the literal count 63 if tests change; imports resolve runtime cwd and environment.
evidence: RUN_ALL_LOG.txt and summary are accepted as historical reported executions only. No fresh run or certification of all child code is claimed. Per-source read completion is independent of dependency closure.

role: Stationary Toeplitz Gram chart and full-rank Fourier evaluator.
logic: States a_i=1+iK,beta=3s+i(K+1) give V=D W; exponent nodes reduce to u mod K, so Vandermonde columns are independent and q=M spans all local input blocks. Gram Toeplitz is input/block independent. Public evaluator validates dimensions via bank setup, estimates Gram condition, solves all K right-hand sides for each odd column and decodes q streams.
cost: O(Mq^2+mq^3+Nq+(N/M)q^2+qN+q(N/M)log(K+1)+Nlog(m+1)) literal arithmetic, including an SVD condition check. np.linalg.solve refactors Gamma for each odd column rather than reusing one factorization; extra mq^3 is absorbed because q<=K. At q=M actual work is O(NM+Nlog(K+1)+Nlog(m+1)), FFT-scale for M~log G. Memory O(N) for supported q<=M,K>=M.
guards: Standalone stationary_states/construction omit M|G/M dyadic; G=32,M=3,q=3 passes early guards but the extra iKMr u term need not vanish. Public stationary_eval calls correct inherited validation, so this does not invalidate saved supported cases. Floating Gram condition/residual clamp do not certify exact output error.
evidence: Stored q=M all-basis and numerical diagnostics remain supported. Fixed odd factor and bounded q give restricted subspace linear arithmetic, not arbitrary-input exact fast FFT. The helper guard and repeated factorization discrepancies were already recorded in the preserved Phase14 audit.
